title: College Working Hours and Operating Schedule
content:
Official working hours, operating schedules, and academic timings at DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar:

1. Regular Academic & Instructional Hours:
- Classes and Laboratory Sessions: Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
- Saturday: Special classes, tutorials, training sessions, and lab make-ups (typically 9:00 AM to 1:30 PM).
- Sunday: Closed for academic lectures and administration; open for hostel residents.

2. Administrative & Accounts Offices (R&D Block):
- Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Lunch break: 1:30 PM to 2:00 PM).
- Saturday: 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

3. Central Library (Knowledge Centre):
- Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM.
- Saturday: 8:00 AM to 4:25 PM.
- Closed on Sundays and gazetted public holidays.

4. Campus Amenities & Facilities:
- Campus Canteen & Cafeteria: 8:30 AM to 7:00 PM daily.
- Hostels (Sutlej & Raavi): Open 24/7 for resident students, with mess dining schedules (Breakfast: 7:30 AM - 9:00 AM, Lunch: 12:30 PM - 2:00 PM, Dinner: 7:30 PM - 9:30 PM) and evening security entry curfews.
- Central Computer Centre & Wi-Fi: Active during college academic hours and extended for hostel students.

Note: Operating status on specific public holidays, semester breaks, or weather emergencies follows Punjab Government and IKG-PTU official notifications.
